paras: Lipinia vulcania, also known as the vulcan lipinia, is a species of skink endemic to the Philippines. It is known from two specimens: the holotype was collected at ca. 1700 m above sea level on Mindanao Island in 1857, and another one in southern Luzon in 1956.
